extraction.Name: John Guerue
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes but was told that it had now been issued and I should take it whether or not I wanted it.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold to Stotts and Yancy for $2500, in cash and was given in addition one team of horses worth $250 at the time
extraction.Buyer: Stotts and Yancy for $2500 cash plus one team of horses worth $250
extraction.Occupation/Income: I have 8 children and receive $35 per month as Indian police plus some rations
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered at the agency by Mr. Coe, the Agency Farmer; allottee does not remember exact date but stated it was 'some time ago when the others got forced patents'; no debts or other obligations settled in the deal; did not sign a receipt for the patent to his knowledge; subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, on March 21, 1929; notary commission expires 4/28/32; document number 76
